holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.delayedHint: A quote about 15 minutes old. Values and returns use the last close.

empty.title: No holdings yet
empty.body: Add your first instrument, then record what you bought.

noTransactions.title: No transactions yet
noTransactions.body: Your instruments are set up. Record what you bought to see positions here.

holdings.staleHint: The latest close is more than 3 trading days old.
holdings.unvalued_one: {{count}} position has no price and is left out of the value totals.
holdings.unvalued_other: {{count}} positions have no price and are left out of the value totals.
holdings.caption: Positions with market value, profit and loss in euros

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its stored prices are kept in case you add it again.

empty.title: No instruments yet
empty.body: Add an instrument by its ISIN, or by hand if it has no market price.

instruments.caption: Instruments you have added

addInstrument.title: Add instrument
addInstrument.isinHint: For example IE00B5BMR087. Folio looks up where it trades.
addInstrument.noListings: No listing was found for this ISIN. You can add the instrument by hand.
addInstrument.pick: Pick the listing used for prices
addInstrument.name: Name
addInstrument.handHint: For things without a market price, such as an unlisted bond or a private holding. You enter the prices yourself.
addInstrument.currencyRequired: Enter a currency such as EUR.

editInstrument.title: Edit {{name}}
editInstrument.regionHint: For example Europe, US or Emerging markets. Allocation charts group by it.
editInstrument.sleeveHint: The bucket strategies and drift refer to. Create sleeves under Settings, Sleeves.
editInstrument.benchmarkHint: Benchmarks appear in comparison charts, and beta is measured against the first one.
editInstrument.productUrl: Issuer's page for this fund (web address)
editInstrument.productUrlHint: The fund's own page on the issuer's website, for example the iShares or Vanguard page. The button on the position page then goes straight there.

priceEntry.title: Enter a price for {{name}}
priceEntry.hint: A price you enter is kept: later fetches never overwrite it, and the change is logged.

position.lotsCaption: Open lots with cost and result
position.noPosition: You hold none of this instrument.
position.noPrices: No prices stored yet. They are fetched after the instrument is added; you can also refresh from the System page.
position.justEtfHint: Opens this fund's page on justetf.com, found by its ISIN, in a new tab.
position.issuerPageHint: Opens the fund's page on the issuer's website, in a new tab.
position.findIssuerPageHint: Searches the web for this fund. Found the issuer's page? Save its address under Holdings, Instruments, Edit, and this button will go straight there.
